note: Site header -- renders: Main menu, Simple English Wikipedia, Search, Donate, Create account, Log in
Table of contents -- renders: Contents, Unpin, and section headings (e.g., Characteristics, Hardware) which are structural labels for the article
Page title bar -- renders: article title (e.g., Computer) and language selector
Left navigation tabs -- renders: Article, Talk
Right navigation tabs and tools -- renders: Read, Edit, View history, Tools
Appearance settings -- renders: Appearance, Unpin, Font size, Width, Theme, and their fixed options
Subtitle -- renders: fixed platform copy 'From Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia'

Site footer -- renders: last modified timestamp, rendered with MediaWiki, copyright, Privacy policy, About, Disclaimers, Contact, Code of conduct, Developers, Statistics, Cookie statement, Mobile view, Wikimedia Foundation, Powered by MediaWiki
